name: Can design-build firms work on historic or older homes in Pasadena and Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes can be excellent design-build candidates, but they often carry hidden conditions that affect cost and schedule. Common issues include outdated wiring, undersized plumbing, foundation concerns, prior unpermitted work, and framing that no longer matches current standards. In neighborhoods like Pasadena and Burbank, homeowners may also want to preserve period character while improving layout and performance. That balance requires thoughtful design and careful construction planning. The right design-build firm should know how to work around existing conditions, coordinate structural improvements, and maintain architectural details where possible. Homeowners should ask how the team documents unknown conditions and whether the estimate includes a contingency for concealed damage. Projects involving older homes are often more successful when the builder is involved before design is finalized, because that allows the team to price realism into the plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but older homes often require extra care with structural upgrades, electrical and plumbing replacement, permit coordination, and preserving character details. A design-build firm should understand how to modernize the home without damaging original features.
